Local patch (only deviation from upstream):
- scan.mjs, directory walk (~line 66): fs.statSync(abs) replaced by fs.lstatSync(abs),
  and entries where st.isSymbolicLink() is true are skipped with `continue`.
  Purpose: do not follow symlinks out of the scanned tree (e.g. links to /etc/hostname).
  Upstream lines:  try { st = fs.statSync(abs); } catch { continue; }
  Patched lines:   try { st = fs.lstatSync(abs); } catch { continue; }
                   if (st.isSymbolicLink()) continue;

Not copied: build.mjs, describe.mjs, open.mjs, plan.mjs, recent.mjs, refresh.mjs,
status.mjs, agent.mjs, blueprint.mjs, claudemd.mjs, names.mjs, and any other upstream files.
